description: Ask about your places, explore your SUMA data and insights, add information, and import files with review and confirmation.

interface.longDescription:
The intelligence to make your places exceptional.

SUMA helps you understand how your places are performing, see what needs attention, and know where to act.

Explore what’s working, what’s holding performance back, and the evidence behind SUMA’s recommendations. Across one property or a whole portfolio, focus your team and resources on improvements that make the experience better and the operation more effective.

Built for owners, managers, and operators who want exceptional places and stronger results.

With SUMA in ChatGPT, ask questions about your places, explore your data and insights, add updates, and import files. Your existing SUMA permissions apply.
capabilities: Import files with review and confirmation
defaultPrompt: Show my SUMA places and what needs attention.
Find supporting evidence for my place and link to its sources.
Help me import a file into SUMA and review it before saving.
